Let's take a step back and talk about some benefits
of the Xcode library.
First, discoverability.
As your code base grows,
it can become hard for the users of your code
to know exactly what the key parts of your API are.
The library is a place where developers look
to discover available visual content,

was intended to be used with a clear example

enabling rich visual editing for your content.
So now, let's look at what you need to do

a more descriptive title for the item,

There are several advantages to this.
